Illustrations, Photography & Patterns

Icons have their own page: 324 Heroicons, four variants, one sprite →

Illustrations — Open Doodles (CC0)

Style note. The brief asked for 1950s tech-Memphis vector illustration. No free pack in that style exists, so per the brief's fallback these are Open Doodles (Pablo Stanley, CC0) — a friendly line style, not the target aesthetic. The pipeline is style-agnostic: any two-colour SVG pack drops in and re-themes the same way, so a matching set can replace these without touching a template. Treat the current set as a placeholder for tone, not a decision.

Tokenized at build: accent fills resolve to --illustration-accent and line work to --illustration-line. Switch any theme axis — they re-theme live.

Surface patterns

Transparent, gradient-built, and token-bound — add a fds-pattern-* class to any surface and it adapts to the active theme.

Photography

Direction: 1950s retro-futurism — atomic-age optimism, brushed chrome, saturated Kodachrome. Scenario set: hero backdrops, team/collaboration, product-in-hand, abstract texture.
